name: Sakurai Haruyoshi
source: The protagonist of the game (controlled by the player). A mysterious power awakened inside of him after he obtained the key left by his father. Shortly after he met many mysterious people. He's sometimes called Harumi (a girl's name) by other characters since that's a more common reading of his given name's character combination and his long hair.
